name: Heileen: A Trip to Bavaria
source:
Heileen: A Trip To Bavaria tells the story of a trip Heileen did for her 16th birthday to a small village in Bavaria.

There she will met Magdalene and they will become very good friends, but… what are Magdalene's real intentions?

[Edited from [url=http://mac.softpedia.com/get/Games/Heileen-A-Trip-To-Bavaria.shtml]Softpedia[/url]]
translation:
《Heileen: A Trip To Bavaria》讲述海琳十六岁生日时前往巴伐利亚一座小村庄旅行的故事。

在那里，她会遇见玛格达莱娜，两人也将成为非常要好的朋友；但是……玛格达莱娜真正的意图究竟是什么？
